checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: 5 seconds long, follows first 5s of talk-one.mp4
must.why: The 5 s clip keeps the same kitchen, pose and motion as the source.

The face looks like a generic brunette with lighter brows. It does not show the portrait's dark thick brows, face shape or look. It is not clearly the portrait woman, and it may be mostly the original face.

must.item: Original kitchen, body motion and framing remain
must.why: The kitchen, sweater, hair, hands and framing are unchanged.
The clip has sound with peak -0.9 dB, but the speech cannot be heard. The mouth movement suggests the timing is kept.

must.item: Face aligned during movement, no flicker or doubled features
must.why: The sampled frames show a stable face with no doubled features, including when the head tilts down.

faults.what: The swapped face does not resemble the portrait. It has no dark brows and no portrait identity, so the main request failed.
The face looks slightly altered but still like the original woman, so the swap is weak or only partial.

summary: The clip is clean, stable and keeps the framing, but the face does not look like the portrait woman, so the face swap did not work.
